title: Stormblast Bolts Guide — Charged Bolts, Detonators and Weapon Set Rules
summary: Stormblast Bolts fires Charged Bolts that stick into the ground and enemies. They do almost no damage on their own — you must detonate them with a Detonator skill (Explosive Shot, Explosive Grenade, Voltaic Grenade, Oil Grenade, or a Ballista) to deal a big lightning burst. The classic Tactician plan preloads bolts, then detonates all of them at once on a boss.
description: Stormblast Bolts deep guide: Charged Bolts that persist and must be detonated, the Detonator compatibility matrix, weapon-set ownership and which stats apply on detonation, bolt limits, mapping and boss rotations, recommended supports and real community questions.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial
imageAlt: Stormblast Bolts lightning crossbow skill icon

sections.title: Quick Answer
paragraphs: Stormblast Bolts shoots Charged Bolts that embed in the ground and enemies. The bolts themselves barely damage — the payoff is detonating them.

A Detonator skill is required: Explosive Shot, Explosive Grenade, Voltaic Grenade, Oil Grenade, or a Ballista (such as Mortar Cannon). When a Detonator hits near your bolts, they all explode for lightning damage.

The Tactician boss plan is: preload a stack of bolts where the boss will appear, drop your detonators, then fire more bolts so everything detonates at once for a huge burst. Without a Detonator the skill is nearly useless.

properties.label: Core loop
notes: Bolts do little alone; a Detonator skill triggers the explosion.

properties.label: Detonators
properties.value: Explosive Shot / Grenade / Voltaic / Oil / Ballista
notes: Any skill with the Detonator tag sets the bolts off.

properties.label: Acquisition
notes: Obtained from an Uncut Skill Gem; sockets into a crossbow skill slot.

properties.label: Best role
notes: Excels at one-shotting bosses with a stacked detonation; weak for clear alone.

sections.title: Requirements
paragraphs: There is no special attribute gate, but you must run at least one Detonator skill alongside Stormblast Bolts, or the bolts never explode. Most players pair it with Explosive Shot or Explosive Grenade, or use a Ballista like Mortar Cannon.
Ammo works like other crossbow skills: one round loads, fires the bolt fan, reloads quickly.

keyValues.label: Detonator skill
notes: Without it, bolts persist but never deal their burst.

sections.title: Charged Bolts
paragraphs: Each shot plants a set of Charged Bolts in the world. They are owned by you, not by the crossbow that placed them, which matters for weapon-set swaps (see below).

Bolts persist for a limited duration — long enough to preload a boss arena before the fight starts, then they expire if not detonated. You can place a stack of several bolts; Tactician builds commonly preload a dozen or more before detonating.
The bolt's own hit is minor. All the damage is in the detonation explosion triggered by a Detonator. So the skill is really a 'load then trigger' weapon, not a direct-damage skill.
bullets: Bolts are player-owned and persist for a limited time.
You can stack several bolts before detonating.
Real damage comes from the Detonator explosion, not the bolt hit.

sections.title: Detonator Compatibility Matrix
rows: Historically debated; current client treats it as a detonator
Detonates via its grenade tag, not just 'explodes'

sections.title: Bolt Limits and Expiry
paragraphs: There is a cap on how many bolts can exist at once; once you hit it, older bolts stop being placed or expire to make room. Preloading far more than the cap is wasted.
Bolts that leave your view or sit too long expire on their own. In bossing you usually place them right before the detonation window so they are all live when you trigger.

keyValues.label: Max bolts
notes: Over-preloading past the cap wastes bolts.

keyValues.label: Expiry
notes: Place bolts just before detonation for bossing.

sections.title: Weapon Set Rules
paragraphs: Because bolts are owned by you (not by the set that placed them), you can place bolts in Weapon Set 1 and detonate them from Weapon Set 2. The key question players ask is which stats apply at detonation.

In client testing the detonation uses the Detonator skill's own modifiers and the stats of the weapon set that is active at the moment of detonation. So if you swap to a set with a stronger crossbow or more lightning scaling before triggering, the explosion benefits from that set.

keyValues.label: Detonate in Set 2
notes: Swap to the scaling set before detonating for max burst.

sections.title: Hit Behaviour
paragraphs: The bolt placement hit is light. The detonation is a lightning area burst centred on the bolts. Multi-bolt detonations stack their explosions, which is why a preloaded stack deletes a boss.

Detonation area and damage scale with the Detonator skill and its supports, not with Stormblast Bolts' own supports alone. This is why the skill's supports are chosen for bolt placement utility (range, bolt count) while the damage comes from the Detonator.

keyValues.label: Detonation burst
notes: The real damage; stack bolts for a bigger combined burst.

sections.title: Support Compatibility
paragraphs: Supports for Stormblast Bolts should improve bolt placement (more bolts, range) rather than try to scale the detonation directly — the detonation scales off the Detonator. Quality is a known trap: adding Quality to Stormblast Bolts can shift its elemental balance and break Trinity-style equal-damage requirements in some builds, so many guides deliberately leave it unqualified.

keyValues.label: Bolt count / range supports
notes: More bolts placed = bigger stacked detonation.

keyValues.label: Quality
notes: Can break Trinity equal-damage balance in some builds.

keyValues.label: Direct damage supports
notes: Detonation damage comes from the Detonator, not these.

sections.title: Support Loadouts
paragraphs: Keep Stormblast Bolts' supports focused on placement. Put your damage scaling on the Detonator skill instead.

steps.label: Placement supports
steps.action: Socket bolt-count and range supports on Stormblast Bolts.
steps.result: More bolts preloaded for a bigger burst.

steps.label: Damage on Detonator
steps.action: Socket lightning and area supports on Explosive Shot / Grenade / Ballista.

steps.label: Skip Quality
steps.action: Leave Stormblast Bolts unqualified if your build uses Trinity.

sections.title: Mapping Rotation
paragraphs: For clear, Stormblast Bolts is usually secondary to Galvanic Shards. You place a few bolts and detonate them with Explosive Shot as you move, or skip the skill entirely for speed.

steps.label: Place a few bolts
steps.action: Fire Stormblast Bolts into a pack.

steps.label: Detonate
steps.result: Bolts explode for a clear burst.

sections.title: Bossing Rotation
paragraphs: Bossing is the skill's home. Preload bolts where the boss will spawn, set your detonators, then trigger everything at once.

steps.label: Preload bolts
steps.action: Fire 15-20 Stormblast Bolts at the boss spawn point before it appears.
steps.result: A live stack of bolts waits.

steps.label: Set detonators
steps.action: Place Ballistas / Mortar Cannons or ready Explosive Shot.

steps.label: Detonate
steps.action: Fire more bolts or trigger the detonators as the boss becomes targetable.
steps.result: All bolts explode together for a massive burst.

sections.title: Build Usage
paragraphs: Tactician crossbow: the signature home. Galvanic Shards clears, Stormblast Bolts is preloaded and detonated on bosses for one-shot bursts, often with Mortar Cannon as the automated Detonator.
Gemling / generic crossbow: any build that runs a Detonator can use Stormblast Bolts as a boss burst, swapping to it for the preload-detonate play.
Grenade builds: Voltaic or Oil Grenade users already have a Detonator, so Stormblast Bolts slots in as bonus burst.
bullets: Tactician: Galvanic clear + Stormblast boss burst.
Any Detonator build: drop-in boss burst.
Grenade builds: natural fit with existing detonators.

sections.title: Troubleshooting
paragraphs: Bolts do no damage: you have no Detonator skill. Direct answer: socket Explosive Shot / Grenade / Voltaic / Oil or a Ballista and hit near the bolts.
Bolts vanished before the boss: they expired. Direct answer: place them right before the detonation window, not minutes earlier.
Crossbow stuck / no bolts placed: you hit the bolt cap or ammo is empty. Direct answer: reload and don't over-preload past the cap.
Detonation feels weak: your Detonator lacks lightning/area scaling. Direct answer: move damage supports onto the Detonator skill.

steps.label: No Detonator
steps.action: Add a Detonator skill and hit near bolts.

steps.label: Bolts expired
steps.action: Preload closer to the trigger moment.

steps.label: Weak burst
steps.action: Scale the Detonator, not Stormblast Bolts.

sections.title: Known Issues and Edge Cases
paragraphs: Voltaic Grenade used to be debated as a Detonator — some players reported it not triggering bolts on certain patches. On the current client it carries the Detonator tag and detonates bolts; if you see no explosion, confirm the grenade actually lands near the bolts.
Weapon-set swaps can drop your Shock or Detonator if those skills live only in the other set. Keep the Detonator and any Shock source present in the set you detonate with.
Do not confuse 'a skill explodes' with 'a skill is a Detonator'. Only skills with the Detonator tag set off Stormblast Bolts; a generic explosion does not count.
bullets: Voltaic Grenade: current client detonates; land it near bolts.
Keep Detonator + Shock in the active set.

sections.title: Community Evidence
paragraphs: The Tactician Stormblast Bolts guide is one of the most-referenced endgame crossbow builds, with players reporting 30-stack detonations hitting for tens of millions on bosses.
Forum threads repeatedly ask 'why won't Voltaic Grenade detonate my bolts' — the answer is tag and placement, not a missing gem.
Players warn about the Quality trap: adding Quality to Stormblast Bolts can break Trinity in some builds, so many leave it unqualified.
bullets: Tactician preload-detonate is a proven boss tech.
Voltaic Grenade questions are about tag/placement.
Quality trap with Trinity is widely noted.
